completion_scope: Requested arms and selected input artifact coverage only; no claim of whole experiment completion.

scope.membership_rule: Original board members intersect fixed selected IDs; empty discarded; singleton retained.

leaderboard.conventions: PC/RC/RBO unchanged official; RBO ranks distinct numeric values; AO uses paper IDs, official metric direction, ID tie-break; empty prediction=0; all retained boards in denominator.

matching_semantics.Task_Dataset_Metric: Exact label equality; no semantic matching.
matching_semantics.TDM_Exact_Match: Original official unique exact (Task, Dataset, Metric) tuples.
